turnaround_reason: Sleep-apnea implant maker fell from $147 to $51 over the past year on fears GLP-1 drugs (Zepbound, Wegovy) would erode its addressable market plus a 2026 guidance reset; now basing after a strong recent bounce (+22% in 30 days) with insiders net buying and new product (Inspire V / SleepSync) launching.
bullish_points: Profitable and cash-generative despite the selloff: profit margin 14.3%, FCF $85.6M TTM, current ratio 6.3x, debt/equity only 3.7 -- fortress balance sheet, no financing risk
Trailing P/E of 11x is unusually cheap for a device company with 86% gross margins -- the market is pricing this as a structurally impaired business, not a temporary setback
Last three quarterly EPS prints beat estimates by 138%, 142%, and 324% -- consistent, large positive surprises suggest guidance has been reset conservatively
Net insider buying over the last 6 months (210,670 shares net purchased across 26 transactions) -- people close to the business are accumulating, not selling ahead of GLP-1 fears playing out

SLEEP 2026 data showed hypoglossal nerve stimulation may improve cardiovascular risk markers vs. CPAP/untreated -- differentiates INSP beyond just apnea symptom relief, which could support reimbursement and clinician preference even as GLP-1 use grows

The bear case (GLP-1s kill demand) is well known and heavily discounted already -- stock is down 65% from its 52-week high; further downside requires the thesis to get *worse* from here, not just persist
Emerging view that GLP-1s and INSP are more complementary than competitive: many OSA patients remain third-line-treatment eligible regardless of weight-loss drug use
bearish_points: Revenue growth has stalled to +1.6% TTM -- this is a name whose 20%+ growth narrative broke, and it hasn't shown it can re-accelerate yet
BofA downgraded to Underperform with a $39 price target (below current $51) in 2026, and flagged issues 'lasting into 2028' -- at least one credible bear thinks this drags on for years

Forward P/E of 40x vs trailing 11x implies the Street expects a sharp near-term earnings dip (consistent with the -$0.25 EPS estimate for the upcoming quarter) -- next print could disappoint even if beats have been the pattern
Options market is thin: only 109 calls / 98 puts total open interest -- poor liquidity for anyone wanting to trade this with options
GLP-1 adoption is still in its early innings; even a modest structural share shift over multiple years could cap the multiple regardless of near-term beats
-27% below the 200-day MA -- still technically in a downtrend, the 30-day bounce is not yet a confirmed trend reversal
catalyst: Q2 2026 earnings + continued execution on Inspire V / SleepSync rollout -- market wants proof revenue growth is re-accelerating, not just EPS beats against a lowered bar
suggested_trade: Small starter spot position only; skip options given thin open interest and wide bid/ask risk
key_risk: GLP-1 drug adoption continues eating into OSA device demand and revenue growth stays stuck near zero, validating the BofA bear case and keeping the multiple compressed for years
would_skip_if: Q2 revenue growth decelerates further from the current +1.6% TTM pace, or management cuts guidance again -- that would confirm the structural GLP-1 impairment thesis
